record.title: Ceke–Shiveekhuren coal-export restriction in late 2021 and limited return in May 2022
record.exceptions: The observed 25 May 2022 return allowed limited trial coal-truck movements. It does not establish normal capacity, other goods, passengers, or uninterrupted restriction for every exporter.
record.imposing_authority: Chinese local epidemic-control and port authorities
record.enforcement: Issuer export account and MONTSAME-attributed cargo reporting identify a restricted coal route and actual limited return on 25 May.
record.consequences: No general economic effect is quantified by this research packet.
record.relationship: Distinct recurrence from R3-EA-006, which concerns February–March 2020. The 2021–2022 issuer and cargo reports establish a later coal interruption; no new parent found in the complete current/pending union.
record.status_observation: Historical dated evidence only; an unknown endpoint is not evidence of present open or closed status.
record.current_timing: dated evidence; numeric duration withheld; see qualification
record.current_corrections: Port-onset timing is unresolved: mid-October reporting, late-October local measures and November company-export suspension are different descriptions. Mine shutdown is a separate event. The 25 May 2022 coal trial return was limited and is not full-capacity restoration. No numeric duration or unbroken all-exporter closure is inferred.

access_history.limitation: No exact port-closure onset. Its separately reported early-November mine shutdown is not border closure. Company experience does not establish every exporter’s continuity.
